title: RD lookup returns relative href+ep instead of resolved target URIs
description: RFC 9176 s6.1: resource lookup MUST return fully resolved targets (base+href). spec/appendix-misc.md C.2 shows absolute coap://[node]/path links. Current CBOR hits are {href: /temperature, ep: sensor-42, rt: sensor}. Clients cannot form a CoAP URI without a side channel. href=coap://... queries also cannot match stored path-absolute hrefs. Needs a defined resolution rule for LICHEN (Yggdrasil /128 vs registration base vs ep name).
